name: Taskmaster Viccia

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Uppercut
abilities.description: Taskmaster Viccia winds up her hammer and strikes hard, dealing massive physical damage and knocking you back. This attack can be blocked to stagger Taskmaster Viccia instead.

abilities.name: Lashing Chains
abilities.description: If you are far from her, Taskmaster Viccia pulls to her all players in the direction she is facing which deals moderate-high physical damage. This can be blocked to negate to pull. Additionally, be aware of the placement of Taskmaster Snares to avoid being pulled through them.

abilities.name: Discharge
abilities.description: Taskmaster Viccia rakes her hammer across the floor then slams it into the ground, causing a massive shockwave, dealing very high shock damage and knocking you back, indicated by a growing circular AoE. The area of the slam remains charged with electricity for a duration, dealing continuous high shock damage.

abilities.name: Capture
abilities.description: Taskmaster Viccia raises her hammer to the sky, causing four (in normal mode) or six (in veteran mode) Taskmaster Snares to be applied in various spots of the arena, indicated by circular AoEs. Stepping in them causes an explosion that deals very high shock damage (Jolt). These can linger long enough that they will still exist when the next application occurs.

abilities.name: Execute
abilities.description: Taskmaster Viccia channels a lightning attack at a player that stuns them and they cannot break free of it. If this isn't interrupted, the target is always dealt lethal shock damage.

Pledge: The Cauldron: Enter the Cauldron and return Undaunted.
summary: Taskmaster Viccia is a Xivilai found in the Howling Cavern section of the Cauldron. She serves as the second boss of the dungeon. She wields a maul in combat. During the fight you will also need to avoid her traps.
